entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `keyword` TEXT NOT NULL, `answer` TEXT NOT NULL)

indices.name: index_SkillEntity_keyword
indices.createSql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_SkillEntity_keyword` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`keyword`)

entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`keyword` TEXT NOT NULL, `answer` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`SkillEntity`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_SkillEntityFts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `SkillEntity` BEGIN DELETE FROM `SkillEntityFts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_SkillEntityFts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `SkillEntity` BEGIN DELETE FROM `SkillEntityFts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_SkillEntityFts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `SkillEntity` BEGIN INSERT INTO `SkillEntityFts`(`docid`, `keyword`, `answer`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`keyword`, NEW.`answer`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_SkillEntityFts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `SkillEntity` BEGIN INSERT INTO `SkillEntityFts`(`docid`, `keyword`, `answer`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`keyword`, NEW.`answer`); END
